tickets.title: Send benefits enrollment outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: Help Nora Thimblefern evaluate benefit elections for the upcoming enrollment period.

Suggested message:
Hello Nora Thimblefern,

As you review your benefits enrollment materials, please send any plan summaries or election options you would like us to review. Helpful items may include medical, dental, vision, HSA or FSA options, disability coverage, life insurance, retirement plan contribution choices, employer match details, and any deadline shown in your enrollment portal.

If you would like us to coordinate with another professional, please provide:
Professional contact name: [contact name]
Role or firm: [role or organization]
Email or phone: [contact information]
Permission to contact them: [yes/no]

Questions to highlight:
- Are there expected family, employment, or health coverage changes?
- Are you considering HSA, FSA, or dependent care elections?
- Do you want retirement contribution or Roth versus pre-tax guidance?
- Are any employer-paid benefits changing?

Thank you,
[team member name]

The Clockwork Clover Analytics portal shows a closing notice for benefit elections and still lists contingent beneficiaries using old addresses for Lena and Owen, so confirm the current 401(k) beneficiary designations and any updated election choices before the enrollment deadline.

tickets.title: Review inheritance intake information
tickets.text:
Review criteria:
- Source of inheritance or estate distribution and relationship to the client.
- Expected asset types, including cash, securities, retirement accounts, real estate, business interests, personal property, or insurance proceeds.
- Estimated timing and whether distributions are pending, partial, or complete.
- Tax character of each asset, including inherited IRA rules, basis information, estate tax filings, and income tax reporting needs.
- Required documents and evidence to collect: estate or trust correspondence, distribution statements, beneficiary forms, death certificate if needed, account statements, appraisal or valuation reports, real estate documents, tax forms, and contact information for the executor, trustee, attorney, or CPA.
- Client intentions for use of funds, including spending, debt payoff, investing, gifting, charitable giving, or education funding.
- Any conflicts, restrictions, disclaimers, creditor issues, or special handling needs.

Prepare a summary of missing evidence, planning opportunities, and items requiring coordination with legal or tax professionals.

The expected inheritance for Nora Thimblefern from her mother Ellen Thimblefern's estate is estimated between $170,000 and $220,000 and may include cash and an inherited IRA based on preliminary executor correspondence.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete inheritance intake from Ellen Thimblefern’s estate by 2025-12-18.
